name: bswrwa-vault-password-generation
goal: Prove that a single scoped approval can generate and store a password, fill only the reviewed signup form in a disposable browser, and return a secret-free result after teardown.

evidence: Require exact reviewed project/environment/account/recipe scope and a single phone decision. Store before filling a private POST form, verify account and tear down before success, and return status only. Synthetic account qualification uses no real provider or existing browser.
